headline: Revenue in line; better-than-expected profitability

highlights: For 1HFY27, revenue grew 37% YoY.  Service EBITDA grew 50% YoY to INR450m (9% beat), translating into a 13.2% service EBITDA margin (10% in 2QFY26).

Loss at EBITDA level was at INR210m vs INR360m in 2QFY26 and our estimate of INR259m.  The company witnessed a loss of INR257m in 2QFY27 compared to a loss of INR462m in 2QFY26 and our estimate of INR332m.  Management is focused on moving a larger proportion of partners toward multi-category distribution through training, customer-level lead identification, and centralized expert support.

There exists significant operating flexibility, with the ability to rationalize ~INR500–600m of discretionary costs if required.  We have largely maintained our estimates with revenue expected to grow at FY26-28 CAGR of 36%.
We reiterate our BUY rating with a revised TP of INR75 (average of our current and worst- case TP based on 14x Sep’28E EV/EBITDA).
valuation: We reiterate our BUY rating with a revised TP of INR75 (average of our current and worst- case TP based on 14x Sep’28E EV/EBITDA).
Valuation and view  Turtlemint continues to deliver strong growth in volumes, driven by robust demand in health and motor insurance.
